'''Mount Tellec''' was a mountain on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. The [[Dawn Temple]] was built by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on a flat plateau on Mount Tellec. An [[Water/Legends|icy]] waterfall fed into a lake, which was located south of [[Frostwall Village]].<ref name="LotL" />
